references.text: Aaron was asked to place a jar of manna before the testimony for safekeeping, just as Aaron's staff was to be placed before the testimony.
The testimony (the law) was kept in the ark, and Aaron's staff was to be laid before the testimony as a sign.
The testimony was placed in the ark, and the mercy seat was above it - the place where Aaron's staff was to be stored.
The Lord had previously said that the chosen man's staff would sprout, and this would stop Israel's complaints - now this promise is fulfilled.
In the Hebrew text (17:25), the command to lay down the staff as a sign against the rebels is repeated, as mentioned in 17:10.
The Epistle to the Hebrews mentions Aaron's staff that sprouted, kept in the ark together with the jar of manna and the tablets of the law.
